FAQ

Common questions

Who can apply?

Students, aspiring freelancers, entrepreneurs, beginners and professionals are all welcome to apply.

Which courses does MTS Training Centre offer in Lahore?

We offer four practical courses in Lahore: Digital Marketing, AI and Automation, E-Commerce and Graphic Designing.

Can these courses help me start freelancing?

Yes. Our courses focus on hands-on projects and practical skills that students can use for freelancing, online earning, running a business or building a career.

Do I need prior experience?

Our courses are beginner-friendly. Prerequisites for each course are confirmed by the institute.

How do I apply?

Complete the admission form on this page and send it through WhatsApp. Our team will contact you about the next steps.

What are the fees and schedules?

The regular fee is Rs. 20,000 per month. A special offer price of Rs. 15,000 per month is available until 1 November 2026. Durations and schedules are confirmed by the institute, so please contact us for the latest details.
